Commentary.Commentary: The last over couldn't have been more miserable for India, just the five runs and three wickets. Looking at the scoreboard, England would be the happier side. But the chase won't be a walk in the park given the long boundaries and the assistance for spin. It goes without saying that early wickets would be crucial for the hosts. Join us in a bit for the chase.

Jordan stood out with his spell of 4-0-22-3 along with Ali who chipped in with another tight spell. England once again bowled to their plans and managed to keep India in check all the while. The Indian skipper would hope that his bowlers will also learn something from the English bowlers and rely on the change in pace along with accurate lines.

A similar story to the one in Kanpur, though the deck assisted the bowlers a lot more than it did there. Lots of slower balls, tight bowling by Moeen Ali and poor shots by India. Virat Kohli gave the side some momentum with his 15-ball 21. But as soon as he departed, the runs dried up owing to Suresh Raina and Yuvraj Singh's struggle against spin. However, KL Rahul, going through a lean patch, calmed things down and scored boundaries at regular intervals. Though a couple of them were lucky, India won't mind that. He scored a vital half century but probably got out at the wrong time.

OUT! Dhoni departs! Jordan bowls it outside off on a fuller length, Dhoni goes for the big shot over cover but only manages to drag it back onto the stumps. Jordan is pumped up and why not! England have done superbly to restrict India to a score of 144/8!
Jasprit Bumrah is the new batsman but it will be MS Dhoni on strike. Can he finish it off in style?

OUT! Another one sacrifices himself! Dug in short on the stumps, Dhoni pulls it hard through square leg. They have to come back for the second. Amit Mishra is caught way short of his crease as Moeen Ali's throw is accurate and Jordan does the rest.
Smart bowling! Dhoni expects the short one, gets a fuller one wide outside off. He is down the track and can only find extra cover with his drive. They do not take the single.
Amit Mishra walks in next.

OUT! Unfortunate for Pandya! Jordan spears it full on the stumps, Pandya hits it dead straight and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. Dhoni had already ran as expected, Jordan fields the ball and runs Pandya out, uprooting one of the stumps. An unfortunate way to go but England won't mind it. India may not as well with Dhoni back on strike...
WIDE! Slips a slower one down the leg side, Pandya lets it go. An extra run for the home side.
Yorker to Pandya who digs it out towards long on and scampers back for a second.
Short ball from Chris outside off, Dhoni pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a single. So England are not going to bowl full at all to MS. Good ploy, one reckons.
Slower one outside off, Pandya looks to go over mid-wicket with the spin but fails to put bat to ball. Tymal Mills finishes with 4-0-36-1!
Hardik Pandya is the new batsman.

OUT! Pandey misses, Mills hits! Mills bowls it off his back of the hand, on the stumps, Manish has not picked it at all giving himself room. He misses his shot through the off side and has his furniture disturbed. End of a struggling knock by him.
Sloppy from Stokes! Bangs it short on the stumps, Pandey pulls it through mid-wicket for a single. There is a wild throw from the fielder, Stokes at the keeper's end and they get another one.
SIX! Pandey goes the distance! Slower fuller one outside off, Pandey gets under it and swings it through the line, over long on for a maximum. Much-needed boundary for him and India.

Length ball angling into the batsman, Dhoni pulls it hard to short fine leg where Rashid gets to the ball. Unlucky MS? But Rashid does not throw the ball for some reason and Dhoni completes the single.
Shorter outside off, Pandey mistimes his cut through covers for a single.
Tymal Mills comes back on for his final over. Dhoni calls for a change of bat.

Length delivery, on leg, Pandey waited for it and whacked it towards deep mid-wicket. You cannot keep Stokes out of action, can you? Runs across from his position and makes a good save. Poor running this by India should've ran two.
Back of a length delivery, Dhoni hops and cuts it straight to point for a single.
Brilliant yorker, right in the block hole. Pandey did well to dig it out as he digs it towards short fine leg. One run added to the total.
Length delivery, around off, Dhoni drives it to covers for a single and gets off the mark.
MS Dhoni walks in to bat. It is not an easy pitch to hit out and India need quick runs. Interesting period of play.

OUT! Rahul cannot believe it. Slower one, around off, Rahul had picked up the cutter and was looking to heave it over deep mid-wicket. He couldn't connect it and there wasn't any elevation too. Stokes takes a sitter in the deep. The cutters and slower ones finally give results to England.
Good length delivery, outside off, Pandey wanted to drive it over covers but mistimes it straight to the cover fielder for a single.
Chris Jordan back for a spell at the death.

FOUR! Unlucky Stokes! Full toss outside off, Rahul looking for the booming drive, gets an outside edge as the ball squirts down to the third man fence for a boundary. Stokes is not happy but that is how the game works at times.
Slower one outside off, Pandey looks to muscle it through covers and gets an inside edge past the stumps for a single.
50-run stand between KL Rahul and Manish Pandey!
Too full on middle, Pandey slams it down the ground for a couple of runs. This is good bowling from England, keeping India in check.
Slower one outside off, Rahul can only slice it to third man. Mills does well to counter the spin on the ball in the outfield and stops it with his left hand. A single taken.
Works one through mid on for a single.
Bowls it fuller on the stumps, Rahul is caught on the charge and mistimes it towards mid off for a single.
Short of a length, outside off, Rahul pulls it down the ground. For a moment, it seemed that long on will take it, but it fell short of the fielder. One run taken.
Slower one again, outside off, Pandey pulls it with one hand to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Similar delivery, Rahul wants to pull it towards mid-wicket, miscues and the ball rolls to short fine leg. One run added to the total.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Pandey pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Excellent variation. Mills bowls the slower delivery, on middle, Rahul couldn't comprehend it and takes a blow. Pandey sets off for a run and completes it easily.
Back of a length delivery, around middle, Pandey moved back a little, looking to slap it towards leg side. The ball takes the toe end and goes towards mid on as the pair rotate the strike.
Tymal Mills comes back on for a bowl. He was in top form in the last game, will India manage to hit him out today.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Some drama in Nagpur here. There was a noise as Buttler collected Stokes' length delivery. Oh, it's hit the off stump and the bails didn't come off. A lucky escape for Pandey who was backing away to play his shot but was beaten by the lack of pace.
Slower one again, outside off. Rahul shuffled across, looking to play the scoop. But the ball raps his pads and goes to point for a leg bye.
Slower delivery, outside off. Rahul didn't pick the change in pace. He wanted to cut and missed it. Buttler collects it on the second bounce.
Back of a length delivery, Pandey moves back and cuts it to covers without total control. One run added to the total.
Good length delivery, outside off, Pandey looked to pull it but miscues it towards Jordan at mid-wicket.
Ben Stokes back into the attack.
Floats it on leg, Pandey knocks it towards mid on for a single. 12 runs from the over.
A touch short on the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Easy runs! Floats it outside leg, Rahul does not miss out and sweeps it fine to the fence. These are too easy to put away.
Tossed up outside off, Pandey does not pick it and looks to drive it through covers. Gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a single.
Rahul gets across and turns it through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Floats it outside off, Rahul comes down and spanks it hard and over extra cover for a boundary. That was well hit by Lokesh!
Adil Rashid returns for a bowl.
Lands it outside off, Rahul gets across and paddles it down to fine leg for a single. End of another top spell from Moeen Ali, he ends with figures of 4-0-20-1!
Floats it outside off, Pandey turns it through long on for a single.
Just wide! KL Rahul goes back and works it just wide of the diving short mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, Pandey drives it to long on for a single. He is doing the smart thing, giving strike to the set batsman.
Maiden T20I fifty for KL Rahul!
Fires it on the pads, Rahul clips it through square leg for a single. Important knock by Rahul but India will want him to stay till the end.
Drops it short outside off, punched through long on for a single.
FOUR! Low full toss, around middle. Rahul waits for it and whacks it towards cow corner for a boundary. He looks in total command now.
Bowls this on middle, Pandey flicks to backward square leg and runs one.
Bowls this on middle, goes back and plays the late cut through the off side for a single.
Rahul gets a leading edge off this delivery and the ball rolls through covers for a double.
SIX! Tossed up delivery, Rahul dances down the track and slams it over long on for a maximum. Brilliant shot, this! He needs to bat through to ensure India reach a commendable total.
Full toss, nearly waist high, Pandey, pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. It looked like a no ball, Dawson got away with it.
Liam Dawson back on.
Bowls this one on middle, Pandey flicks it through square leg. One run added to the total.
Short ball, sligthly fast. Rahul rocks back and pulls it to backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Pandey pushes it to covers and runs one.
Manish Pandey is the new man in.

OUT! Yuvraj was clearly struggling against the spin and Moeen has the last laugh. Slightly slow around off, Yuvraj looks for the sweep but misses and is hit in front of the stumps. An easy decision for the umpire there. And Yuvraj takes the long walk back to the pavilion for a poor 4 off 12 balls.
Tossed up delivery, on the stumps. Yuvraj goes behind and drives it through covers for a double.
Bowls this one outside off, Yuvraj charges down the ground looking to nudge it towards leg side. But the ball raps his pads.
The groundsmen are out with the rope, trying to reduce the effect of the dew on the outfield.
Bowls this one outside off. Yuvraj dabs it to backward point for a single.
Outside off and it stayed low. Yuvraj wanted to cut but missed.
Tossed up, outside off, Rahul sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a double. The fielder hared across and did well there to keep them to a single.
SIX! This is a gift and Rahul takes it happily. A full toss, Rahul dances down the ground and heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Full toss, Yuvraj flicks it to widish long on for a single and gets off the mark
Slightly flat, down the leg side. Rahul looks to pull it past the fine leg area but misses. He should've put it away but settles for just a run.
Outside off on a length, Yuvraj picks it very late and just about gets his bat down in time. Just a run from that over.
Oh what happened there? Bowls it on off, Yuvraj falls over trying to sweep it. The ball hits him on the pads and then on the stomach. A loud appeal from Moeen but nothing from the umpire.
Picks the quicker one and defends it watchfully.
Spin! Bowls it outside off, turning away, Yuvraj is beaten as he plays inside the line of the ball.
Drives it watchfully through covers for a single.
Shorter outside off, Rahul stays back and punches it towards mid on. The bowler goes to his right and stops it.
Floats it on off, Yuvraj comes forward and defends it. Two runs and a wicket from the first over from Rashid.
Bowls this on the stumps, Yuvraj defends it from his crease.
Yuvraj Singh arrives.

OUT! Raina holes out! Rashid bowls the googly on the stumps, Raina looks to go for the hoick but has not hit it well at all. Jordan gets under the ball at long on and takes the catch. Vital wicket for England and Rashid. India need to ensure they do not lose the momentum here.
Outside leg, Rahul clips it through square leg. Stokes comes in hard and keeps them to a single.
Flatter on the pads, Rahul comes down to work it through but gets hit on his pads.
Fuller outside off, Raina drives it through mid off for a single.
Spin from both ends, Adil Rashid brought on to bowl. He was not used at all in the last match.
Slower delivery, which straightened up after pitching. Rahul wanted to nudge it to leg side but the ball takes a soft leading edge and goes back to the bowler.
Tossed up, outside off, Raina drives through covers and runs one.
WIDE! Full delivery, down the leg side. Raina goes for the sweep and misses.

Cheeky! Tossed up, outside off, Rahul goes for the reverse sweep and beats the keeper. The short third man chased it to save a boundary, there was  slight fumble and hence three runs added to the total.
Short, around leg, Raina goes back and flicks it to mid-wicket for another single.
Floated, on middle. Rahul punches it down the ground for one run.
Tossed up delivery, around off. Raina drives it to long off for an easy single.
Moeen Ali introduced into the attack.
Back of a length delivery, on leg, Raina clips it off his pads to backward square leg for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Length delivery, outside off. Rahul leans forward and drives it to bisect the mid off and cover fielders. Glorious shot this! He's looking in good touch today.
Good length delivery, on leg. Raina shuffles across and flicks to mid-wicket for a single.
On a shorter length, on the stumps. Raina looks to make room to drive it over covers. He doesn't connect and Buttler collects it.
Back of a length delivery, width on offer. Rahul guides it down to third man for a single.
WIDE! Length delivery, way outside off. Rahul has a wild swing and misses.
Another bowling change, Ben Stokes comes on for a bowl.
Too full on off, KL Rahul digs it out towards long on for a single.
Raina manages to get this one past backward point for a single.
ALMOST! Slants a length ball across off, Raina feels for it and almost guides it to the keeper. He for some reason waits on his back foot, probably waiting for the shorter one early.
Bowls this slower and fuller on the stumps, Rahul clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Audacious! Jordan pitches it up outside off, KL Rahul does not miss out and slams it up and over extra cover for a boundary. That really sped to the fence. Jordan is taken back by that hit.
Suresh Raina walks in to bat.

OUT! Virat Kohli departs! Jordan bowls it slower outside off, Kohli is too early into the shot. He has to reach out for it, he wants to go over cover but ends up chipping it in the air towards long on. Dawson gets under the  ball and pouches it safely. End of a small but worthy cameo from the Indian captain. The ploy worked for England to bowl slower one early and England have the big fish.
JUST OVER! KL Rahul waits for another short one, arches back and guides it just over the backward point fielder for a brace. Two runs taken. 15 runs from the over.
Length again from Mills, Kohli mistimes his punch towards mid on for a single. He wanted to pull that one too hard.
This time Kohli just lofts this wider length ball over covers for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Tries the cutter but spills it down the leg side, Kohli gets across and flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.

SIX! Take your hat off to this shot! Mills bowls it outside off on a good length, Kohli just stands tall, punches this one on the up over the long off fence for a maximum. Mills cannot believe it, well he can ask Woakes how it feels but that was just a shot of beauty from Virat Kohli! Not many have hit Mills for a six in his short career so far and that was special.
Bowls it outside off on a length, Kohli mistimes his punch towards mid off. This is a good start for England.
Length delivery, outside off. It was a slower one and Kohli picked it up early. Blocks it towards point.
Short ball, on leg. Rahul pulls it to the same area for a couple.
Similar delivery, on leg. Rahul clips it to backward square leg and runs two. The fielder hared across from square leg and saved a certain boundary
Back of a length delivery, on middle, Kohli flicks to deep mid-wicket for a single.

HUGE APPEAL FOR LBW! Length delivery, angling in. Kohli looked to play the pull and missed it. England went up immediately but the umpire turned it down. It looked quite close though. Replays suggests that it was out.
Good length delivery on the middle, Kohli slams it unconvincingly towards mid on.
Chris Jordan to bowl, only an over for Dawson then.
Back of a length delivery, waist high. Rahul hops and defends it toward square leg.
Back of a length delivery, on middle, Rahul didn't expect that much pace maybe and hits the ball onto his pads. Mills goes ahead to collect it.
Short of a length, Kohli punches it to mid on for a single.

FOUR! Short delivery, outside off, Kohli instantly went for the pull and miscued. All the Indian fans must have had a lump in their throat as the ball sailed over the keeper. The third man fielder made a diving effort but it was too far away from him. Excellent try by Billings though.
Back of a length delivery, angling in. Kohli hops and defends it to point for no run.
Mills, coming round the wicket, bowls a good length delivery on off. Kohli drives it to covers.
Tymal Mills to bowl from the other end.
Short, on middle, Kohli nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated delivery, on leg, Rahul flicks to mid-wicket and runs one.
Slightly fast, on middle, Rahul knocks it back to Dawson.
Similar delivery, outside off, Rahul drives it straight to covers.
Floated on the off, Rahul leans forward and just pushes it to long off. Brilliant running, the fielder was a little slow there and the batsman ran two.
Tossed up delivery, outside off, Kohli drives it to long off for a single.
The players are out in the middle for the national anthems.
India Playing XI - KL Rahul, Virat Kohli(c), Suresh Raina, Yuvraj Singh, MS Dhoni(w), Manish Pandey, Hardik Pandya, Amit Mishra, Jasprit Bumrah, Yuzvendra Chahal, Ashish Nehra.
England Playing XI - Jason Roy, Sam Billings, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan(c), Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler(w), Moeen Ali, Liam Dawson, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Tymal Mills.

Virat Kohli preferably wanted to bowl first. He mentions the (World T20 2016) New Zealand game and thinks it might not be a bad time to bat first. An extra spinner comes in (Mishra comes in as Parvez Rasool misses out). First innings might be the best time to bat on according to the Indian skipper.

Eoin Morgan says the pitch looks like a typical Indian wicket. Informs that they have opted for an extra spinner, Liam Dawson will come in for Liam Plunkett. He says that the team is not taking the last two wins for granted and are taking one game at a time.
TOSS - England have won the toss and will bowl first.

Pitch report - Sunil Gavaskar doing the pitch report thinks that the track might spin more than it did during the 2016 World T20 opener. Nasser Hussain reveals that Liam Dawson might come in the team. SG suggests that captains should bat first after winning the toss. There's the dew factor too.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the 2nd T20I between India and England in Nagpur. An emphatic performance by England in Kanpur saw them take the lead in the 3-match T20I series. Virat Kohli and Co would go for the kill and will look to level the series. However, the last time they played here, New Zealand bundled them out for 79. Can the fortunes change today for the hosts or will England seal the series?
